fields.title: 📖 Sufyān ath-Thawrī: Act upon knowledge
fields.body:
🖋️ **Sufyān ath-Thawrī** said:

> ***“Sufyān ath-Thawrī said in meaning: Knowledge calls to action; if it is answered, it remains, otherwise it departs.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Knowledge without action becomes a burden. Whoever receives Allah’s knowledge should preserve it with obedience.

immutable.source: 📝 Abū Nuʿaym, Ḥilyat al-Awliyāʾ, Überlieferungen von Sufyān ath-Thawrī.
